Síntesis

Base de conocimiento legal construida a partir de OntoPriv y de la Ley Orgánica de Protección de Datos Personales del Ecuador (LOPDP), alineada con el Data Privacy Vocabulary (DPV) y enlazada con el GDPR por medio de GDPRtEXT.

Base de conocimiento legal de privacidad: OntoPriv-LOPDP alineada con el DPV y el GDPR: Descripción volver a índice

Reúne en un solo documento los cuatro módulos de la base: el núcleo reutilizable (OntoPriv-Core), el perfil de Ecuador (LOPDP), la alineación con el DPV aprobada por revisión humana y el puente con el GDPR (GDPRtEXT). Basada en OntoPriv, de G. Suntaxi, K. Ojeda y F. Rodríguez (CLEI 2024), y en su versión basada en el DPV, de G. Suntaxi, K. Ojeda, F. Rodríguez, P. del Hierro, J. Miño y D. A. Flores (2025). La frase de cada concepto con sus correspondencias se escribe solo para esta documentación; los módulos del repositorio no la tienen. Algunos términos de OntoPriv tienen dos tipos a la vez, por ejemplo clase y propiedad (OWL Full): su ficha no muestra la frase, pero la tabla de abajo sí. ### Correspondencias de la base | Concepto | DPV | GDPR | Artículos de la LOPDP | |---|---|---|---| | [a data protection delegate will be assigned](#http://www.semanticweb.org/ley-organica-proteccion-datos-personales#a_data_protection_delegate_will_be_assigned) | está relacionado con dpv:hasDataProtectionOfficer | | | | [Administrative or judicial authorities](#http://www.semanticweb.org/franc/ontologies/2023/9/OntologiaLOPDP#Administrative_or_judicial_authorities) | es un tipo de dpv:Authority | | | | [Admitted Countries](#http://www.semanticweb.org/franc/ontologies/2023/9/OntologiaLOPDP#Admitted_Countries) | es un tipo de dpv:Country | | | | [Advise on risk analysis](#http://www.semanticweb.org/franc/ontologies/2023/9/OntologiaLOPDP#Advise_on_risk_analysis) | está relacionado con dpv:hasRiskAssessment | | | | [affects to](#http://www.semanticweb.org/ley-organica-proteccion-datos-personales#affects_to) | se parece a dpv:hasImpactOn | | | | [Anonymization](#http://www.semanticweb.org/ley-organica-proteccion-datos-personales#Anonymization) | es igual a dpv:Anonymisation | | art. 4, art. 31 | | [Anonymized [Applicability](#http://www.semanticweb.org/ley-organica-proteccion-datos-personales#Applicability) | está relacionado con dpv:Applicability | | | | [Applicable safety OOPS! revisó OntoPriv original y la base el 2026-11-22. La base tiene más elementos que OntoPriv (la alineación, el puente y los conceptos de la LOPDP), así que una parte de los casos nuevos viene de lo agregado. «Toda la ontología» es un problema general, sin elementos que contar. | Código | Problema | Importancia | OntoPriv | Base | Cambio | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | P19 | Defining multiple domains or ranges in properties | crítico | 116 | 0 | corregido | | P11 | Missing domain or range in properties | importante | 115 | 82 | menos casos | | P12 | Equivalent properties not explicitly declared | importante | 3 | 1 | menos casos | | P24 | Using recursive definitions | importante | 3 | 3 | igual | | P34 | Untyped class | importante | 7 | 0 | corregido | | P04 | Creating unconnected ontology elements | menor | 0 | 25 | nuevo | | P07 | Merging different concepts in the same class | menor | 11 | 12 | más casos | | P08 | Missing annotations | menor | 527 | 527 | igual | | P13 | Inverse relationships not explicitly declared | menor | 122 | 121 | menos casos | | P22 | Using different naming conventions in the ontology | menor | 1 | 1 | igual |

anonymizationni Volver a índice o Índice de individuos

IRI: http://www.semanticweb.org/ley-organica-proteccion-datos-personales#anonymization

The implementation of measures to prevent the identification or re-identification of a natural person shall be carried out without incurring disproportionate efforts. This implies that privacy-preserving actions shall be taken without requiring excessive resources, time or effort that are not justified by the benefits or purpose pursued.

application favorable to the ownerni Volver a índice o Índice de individuos

IRI: http://www.semanticweb.org/ley-organica-proteccion-datos-personales#application_favorable_to_the_owner

In situations where there is uncertainty as to how to interpret and apply the legal or contractual provisions related to the protection of personal data, judicial and administrative officials must opt for the interpretation that benefits the owner of such data, i.e., the owner must be favored in terms of protection and safeguarding of his personal data in case of ambiguity or doubt in the application of the Organic Law for the Protection of Personal Data.

actions regarding health data processing dp "For when dealing with anonymized health data"
actions regarding independence of control dp "Investigation action, which involves carrying out investigations into possible violations of data protection legislation in an independent and partial manner."
actions regarding independence of control dp "Prevention action, which consists of promoting good practices and providing guidance and advice to organizations and citizens on how to protect personal data and comply with privacy regulations."
actions regarding independence of control dp "Sanction action, which arises once violations of data protection legislation are identified, whereby the Data Protection Authority has the power to impose appropriate and proportionate sanctions."

authorization for treatment of anonymized health data dp "Provide technical protocol containing the necessary details to ensure the protection of health data."
control functions op "It is the control and oversight body responsible for guaranteeing all citizens the protection of their personal data, and for taking all necessary actions to ensure that the principles, rights, guarantees and procedures set forth in the Organic Law on Personal Data Protection and its implementing regulations are respected."
designation dp "The Personal Data Protection Authority shall be appointed in accordance with the provisions of the Constitution of the Republic."
designation dp "The appointment is made from a list of three candidates provided by the President of the Republic"
designation dp "The selection is based on criteria of specialization and merit, and the process is public, allowing for citizen challenges."
duration of charge dp "The Personal Data Protection Authority will exercise its functions for a period of 5 years."
functions dp "Apply sanctions to those responsible, delegates, persons in charge and third parties, in accordance with the provisions of the Organic Law on Personal Data Protection."
functions dp "Attending to consultations on personal data protection matters"
functions dp "Control and supervise the exercise of the right to personal data protection within the data processing carried out through the National System of Public Registries."
functions dp "Create, manage and administer the National Registry of Personal Data Protection, and collaborate with public and private entities to ensure its correct operation."
functions dp "Establish guidelines for the analysis, evaluation and selection of personal data security measures."
functions dp "Exercise the supervision, control and evaluation of the activities carried out by the person responsible for and in charge of the processing of personal data."
functions dp "Investigate, analyze and resolve complaints filed by data subjects, as well as those initiated by the Personal Data Protection Authority, in addition to imposing appropriate sanctions"
functions dp "Issue guidelines for the design and content of the personal data processing policy."
functions dp "Keep a statistical record of personal data security breaches and identify possible security measures for each of them."
functions dp "Perform or delegate technical audits to the processing of personal data."
functions dp "Periodically publish a guide to personal data protection regulations."
functions dp "Promote adequate and effective coordination with accountability officers and participate in international and regional initiatives for the protection of personal data protection."
functions dp "Promote and encourage the exercise of the right to the protection of personal data, as well as the awareness and understanding of the risks, rules, guarantees and rights of individuals in relation to the processing and use of their personal data, with special emphasis on activities aimed at priority groups such as children and adolescents."
functions dp "To dictate standard data protection clauses and verify the content of additional or specific clauses or guarantees."
functions dp "To issue general or technical regulations, criteria and other acts necessary for the exercise of its powers and the guarantee of the exercise of the right to the protection of personal data."
functions dp "To represent internationally the interests related to the protection of personal data."
known as dp "Data Protection Superintendent"
requirements that must be met dp "Must have at least a fourth level degree and a minimum of 10 years of experience in areas related to the regulation of the Organic Law for the Protection of Personal Data."
requirements that must be met dp "The Personal Data Protection Authority must be a professional in law, information systems, communication or technology."
revocation dp "His mandate can only be revoked by impeachment after an impeachment trial conducted by the National Assembly."
